acceptance_met: Reconciled the stale recoverable-fencing proposal with the newer pinned KL03-10 handler tables: PRODUCER_FENCED and INVALID_PRODUCER_ID_MAPPING are terminal, not recoverable via abort. No production behavior was weakened.

Public client_api coverage exercises four fatal and eight abortable cases across EndTxn v4/v5, including all four older-card error codes. Repeated commit cannot clear either sticky state; fatal fencing sends no EndTxn/re-init; abortable errors recover only after abort.

Classic recovery sends the last authorized (pid,epoch) to InitProducerId; transaction V2 uses EndTxn identity without re-init. A recovered transaction successfully sends/commits with the returned epoch.
Corrected caller guidance: PID mapping errors are fatal, abort-required Produce errors block commit, and init_transactions is an initialization check that cannot clear terminal state.
limits: Mock evidence, not live transactional qualification. Existing non-transactional/idempotent behavior is unchanged.
The original proposed acceptance was unsafe and superseded by KL03-10; the registry records the corrected, source-pinned contract rather than treating fatal fencing as abort-recoverable.
